items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Old man Barbara, you heard him, I'll have to tell you about him. He was a nice musician too.

ctx.x: I've heard of him, but don't know anything about him.

Well, he was a fellow who used to play that trumpet, and he had all them got beats about him. Old man Barbara, you heard him, I'll have to tell you about him. I know you're old boy. He was a nice musician too.
Well, there was Joe Johnson. I knew Bunk Johnson very well. Did you get to hear him when you were a kid?
